result.reasoning: This commit introduced the Biweekly library-based iCalendar export functionality in EventEmail.java, EventsExportEventsToICal.java, CalendarServlet.java, and CalendarExport.java using `Biweekly.write(ical).go()` calls that did not set a default timezone on the writer. The fix commit modifies exactly these same call sites, replacing the simple `Biweekly.write(ical).go()` calls with an `ICalWriter` that explicitly sets `TimeZone.getDefault()` as the default timezone to fix daylight savings/local timezone export issues. The BIC established this exact export logic across all four files, and the bug (missing timezone handling causing incorrect DST behavior) existed from that point forward.
